name: ESCP Business School

about.text: ESCP Business School was founded in 1819, the first business school in the world. It was founded in Paris and has now become a leading global school which is unmistakenly European in character. The university's multi-campus setting includes six cities: Paris, Berlin, London, Madrid, Turin, and Warsaw. The school is part of the highly recognized French Grande École system, as mentioned previously, which has a top-ranking, academically rigorous selection process.

ESCP is also accredited by many academic organizations, including Conférence des Grandes Écoles, and has triple accreditation (AACSB, EQUIS, AMBA), a rare feat for a small number of business schools in the world. Scholastically, ESCP has a rich selection of programmes according to career track. They are undergraduate (management BSc), followed by postgraduate (master's degree in management with specialization in MScs), MBA, Executive MBA or PhD . The Master in Management (MiM) programme was ranked among the world’s leading-edge programmes, in keeping with the excellence in teaching at the school.

One defining aspect of ESCP is the multi-campus learning model, which allows students’ rotation across campuses throughout the course of their learning. This process encourages students of all skills across the world to be more familiar with language and cultures, important for a global business environment. Students graduate with degrees from various countries, and gain an increased job market. The ESCP faculty is very international with a big number of PhD holders and members of various nationalities. The school also ensures close relationships with industry allowing students to intern, consult and network with global companies.

Also, ESCP has a culture that is highly entrepreneurial and innovative. Initiatives such as startup programmes and incubators encourage students to start their own businesses. Its alumni network consists of CEOs, entrepreneurs, and political leaders, giving it even greater global reach and power. This is why ESCP Business School ranks within European schools, but also provides you with top-notch industrial qualifications, international exposure with industry links and connections.

aboutBoxes.title: Online Degree Acceptance
aboutBoxes.content: Online degrees earned from a government-approved university, just like a regular degree, are accepted by the top recruiters worldwide including government & private sectors.

aboutBoxes.title: Value of Online Degree
aboutBoxes.content: An online degree from a government-approved university holds similar recognition in the industry as that of a regular degree. Thus, it is equally valuable when considered for a job or higher education.

aboutBoxes.title: Quality of Education
aboutBoxes.content: The quality of education offered in online programs is of the same standard as offered in an on-campus program. Be it curriculum, faculty members, evaluation methods, practical sessions, online & on-campus programs follow similar standards of quality.

emi.text: ESCP Business School usually requires that tuition fees be paid out in instalments rather than in the old EMI forms. Students will be able to pay dues in organized sub-instalments year-round throughout the course of the academic year. International students benefit from scholarships, financial assistance, and partnerships (such as loans). Students often take out education loans or third-party financing options in their home countries. Depending on the programme and campus, there are flexible payment structures. Pre-enrolment check programme-specific fee breakdowns and payment deadlines on the official website.

admission.text: The ESCP Business School is competitive and has a well-planned multi-step entrance process. This is why applications are usually submitted online, with multiple intake deadlines in the year. High competition has drawn a wide variety of applications, and early applications are advised.

For a course like the Bachelor in Management, students or candidates must either have a high school diploma (or be in the final year) and demonstrate English proficiency at the C1 level. Some of the documents required are academic transcripts, CV, personal statement, and language certificates.

For postgraduate programmes, including the Master's in Management, applicants must possess a bachelor’s degree and speak English. Other requirements can be GMAT, GRE, or other comparable ratings (or an internal test from ESCP). The selection is normally made through:
Assessment of academic and work history
Personal interview with motivation, goals, and personality

Additionally, MBA candidates need to have work experience (3+ years). Successful candidates are offered admission, which must be accepted within a certain period of time. All in all, ESCP seeks candidates with solid academic performance, an international mindset, leadership capabilities, and clear career aspirations.

examination.text: Many courses put an emphasis on practical problem-solving, having students examine real business scenarios. Instead of standard exams, some modules have open-book exams or project-based evaluations. Final grades can also be affected by participation and class engagement, particularly for courses with a heavy discussion element. Its evaluation scheme is consistent with the European Credit Transfer System (ECTS), standardising across campuses. This is not a rote memorisation exam so the exam pattern is more analytical thinking, teamwork, and application of business concepts.
ESCP Business School academic evaluation is a test of academic knowledge as well as practical application. As a rule, exams vary by programme and subject. Assessment methods are as follows:
Written exams, whether case-based or theoretical.

placementText.text: ESCP Business School has robust placement partnerships with global corporations across consulting, finance, technology, and luxury sectors. Recruiters include multinational firms, investment banks, and prestigious consulting companies. The career services, networking opportunities, internship programmes, and alumni networks that are offered to students will all benefit them. Exposure across the multi-campus opens students to foreign markets, making them more employable and internationally marketable. Many of these graduate programs put students in positions of service in consultancies, financial institutions, and multinational companies. ESCP’s excellent reputation and alumni network are the secret to opening and broadening career opportunities all over the world.
